hook: Most AI ads look expensive and say nothing useful.
premise: Lead with the operator frustration, then show a tighter decision loop.
audiencePsychology: This audience wants proof of competence more than flashy polish.

script.text: OppScan organizes opportunity research into one workflow.
That tighter workflow can help a small team act faster.
A blunt, anti-hype opening may stop more skeptical viewers.

storyboard.visualDirection: Desk-level close-up of messy tabs snapping into a single clean dashboard.
storyboard.audioNotes: Dry, no-nonsense VO with a short glitch hit on the cut.

storyboard.visualDirection: Fast over-the-shoulder demo beats showing the workflow compressing.
storyboard.audioNotes: VO tightens pace; subtle mechanical clicks under transitions.

ctaText: Book a demo and see the workflow on your own pipeline.
rationale: The direction stays factual, avoids hype, and matches an operator-minded buyer.
